description: This Java class models a configuration element `<user-transaction-jndi>` within the entity configuration framework of Apache Ofbiz. It primarily encapsulates the attributes jndi-server-name and jndi-name, provides validation during instantiation, and offers getter methods for these properties.

classes.name: UserTransactionJndi
classes.description: A class representing the `<user-transaction-jndi>` XML element used in entity configuration, encapsulating JNDI server and name attributes with validation.

methods.name: UserTransactionJndi
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by extracting and validating jndi-server-name and jndi-name from an XML DOM element.

methods.name: getJndiServerName
methods.description: Returns the JNDI server name attribute value.

methods.name: getJndiName
methods.description: Returns the JNDI name attribute value.
